items.heading: A Platform's Marketing, Pricing Page,
items.text: A platform's marketing, pricing page, and testimonials tell you about the business. They tell you very little about whether the specific person on your call is actually good at this. These four checks are about the person.

items.heading: A Well
items.text: A well-reviewed platform can still hand you a poorly matched counsellor. These four signs are about spotting that mismatch, on top of the usual provider red flags, hidden pricing, guaranteed outcomes.

items.heading: Not Every Conversation Adds
items.text: Not every conversation adds the same thing. This is the difference a genuinely well-matched counsellor points toward.

items.heading: Ask About Real Training
items.text: Ask about real training and background directly. A specific answer is a stronger signal than a general "our counsellors are certified" line.

items.heading: Breadth of Experience Across Different
items.text: Breadth of experience across different life stages usually matters more than raw years in practice.

items.heading: Personalized Advice References Your Actual
items.text: Personalized advice references your actual profile in the reasoning itself, not just in a greeting line.
